New Delhi, the 23rd October, 2017

RESOLUTION

It is announced for general information that during the year 2017-2018, accumulations at
the credit of subscribers to the General Provident Fund and other similar funds shall carry
interest at the rate of 7.8% (Seven point eight per cent) w.e.f. 1st October, 2017 to 31st December,
2017. This rate will be in force w.e.f. 1st October, 2017. The funds concerned are:—

The General Provident Fund (Central Services).
The Contributory Provident Fund (India).

The All India Services Provident Fund.

The State Railway Provident Fund.

The General Provident Fund (Defence Services).
